payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the baseline performance of models in comparison to the wFST-adaptation approach and other models, indicating that the baseline refers to the performance of these models in terms of WER and PER metrics.

claims.text: The baseline performance is represented by the wFST models, which are purely monolingual and do not use data adaptation.
In high resource language experiments, none of the sequence-to-sequence approaches equal the performance of the wFST model in WER and PER, indicating the baseline performance level.
